Global Winners
Congratulations to the 2025 NASA International Space Apps Challenge Global Winners! These winners represent the top 10 projects from the 11,500+ submitted. These projects were chosen by Executive Judges from the
Global Finalists
.
Meet the
2025 Global Winners
and learn what inspired their projects.
Their projects showcase what's possible when we come together to address challenges we face on Earth and in space. We are grateful to the entire NASA Space Apps community for making the hackathon such a success!
The 2025 NASA Space Apps Challenge Global Winners will be announced on December 18th. Stay tuned.
